tagline.en: An embodied world model that generates action-conditioned video for robotics tasks.
tagline.zh: 一个具身世界模型,为机器人任务生成动作条件视频。

en: TesserAct is an embodied world model from the UMass Embodied AGI group. It generates action-conditioned video for robotics — predicting how a scene evolves in response to actions — so it can serve as a learned model of an embodied environment.

In WorldFoundry the official TesserAct source is vendored in-tree and exposed through a runtime pipeline. The pipeline resolves the vendored inference entrypoint; to run generation you stage the TesserAct checkpoint and the embodied-task assets it needs.
zh: TesserAct 是 UMass Embodied AGI 团队推出的具身世界模型。它为机器人生成动作条件视频——预测场景如何随动作演化——因而可以作为具身环境的学习模型。
在 WorldFoundry 中,官方 TesserAct 源已内置,并通过运行时 pipeline 暴露。pipeline 会解析内置的推理入口;要运行生成,需备好 TesserAct 的 checkpoint 及其所需的具身任务资源。

whenToUse.en: When you want an embodied world model that produces action-conditioned video for robotics — modeling how actions change a scene.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个具身世界模型、为机器人生成动作条件视频时——建模动作如何改变场景。

notFor.en: Generation is gated on staging the checkpoint and embodied-task assets first, so it is not ready to run out of the box.
notFor.zh: 生成需先备好 checkpoint 与具身任务资源,因此不能开箱即用。

en: Official source vendored with an in-tree inference entrypoint
zh: 面向机器人的具身世界模型
内置官方源与推理入口
